123009.description:
As the monster's teeth drew near, it was then that I remembered. "I've witnessed this scene before." This was the world of an RPG I played in my previous life. And I, as the main character's childhood friend, was the losing love interest who would be turned down by him in the future. The childhood friend whose role ended one hour into the opening after confessing to the main character as he was about to set off into his journey. The one many players sympathized with as the main character would meet another girl who would cling onto him during his journey. If I remain in this village, in the future I'll be the losing love interest?! To avoid prevent that from happening, I'll leave the village and make use of my newly blossomed ability in compounds with becoming an alchemist at the royal capital as my aim. I don't give a damn about some job that requires me to be the main character's childhood friend. I'll be seizing happiness with my own hands!

(Source: Publisher, translated)

Sakuramori Miu is, by all appearances, a prim and proper young lady with a respectable job in planning and development. There’s no way she could be anything but vanilla and innocent! But when she’s off the clock and behind closed doors, Miu’s got a taste for more sensual pleasures and fetishes. To her surprise, her sales manager, Takeda Shiro, is also hiding his own secret fantasies behind his buttoned-up reputation. When the two match their desires, they’ll make for one steamy office romance!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

123054.description:
Kazuya Kawaguchi has always had a crush on Miki Toda since elementary school, but every time he tries to give her a love letter to confess his feelings, he ends up turning away in fear. Several years later, the two meet at an alumni homecoming. Much to his dismay, Kazuya discovers that Miki doesn't remember who he is, and so puts up an act to hide the fact that the revelation has affected him so. Meanwhile, Miki garners a vague recollection of Kazuya, and so begins feeling similarly dismayed at the fact that he seemingly doesn't remember who she is, either. But just when Miki thinks the night will end in sheer frustration, Kazuya builds the courage to ask her out on a date. And so begins the awkwardly cute love story of these two incidental lovers, where everything started with a stack of undelivered love letters well over a decade overdue.

(Source: Irodori)

Tough but idealistic Koga has just joined the Tokyo branch of SHWD, the Special Hazardous Waste Disposal unit responsible for eradicating mysterious biological weapons that were left behind after the great war. Her mentor is Sawada, a woman with a powerful psyche who complements Koga’s physical prowess. Something is sizzling between the two of them, and it’s more than just a shared mission. Together, these two badass women must team up to confront horrors beyond their wildest nightmares.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

123058.description: One day, a super-clumsy Tanigawa accidentally went to school wearing his sister's underwear. Unfortunately, he was seen by his classmate Matsuyuki, and through a ridiculous misunderstanding thought Tanigawa was some kind of gay pervert? Tanigawa tried to clear up the misunderstanding, but instead just made everything worse! However, Tanigawa gradually becomes attracted to Matsuyuki, who in turn tries to help Tanigawa get rid of his clumsiness.

123059.description:
"Noah, open your eyes! This can't be your last. Please...!"

I was summoned to this world just because I was holding a novel, "The Heart of a Dragon, and I became the second lead character in the novel. And you, the master of the sword and my husband.

Our meeting was so fateful. So I didn't believe your love. Because I thought you loved the heroine, not me.

Unlike the novel, I realized only after you died in vain. I'm a coward. I loved you, but I refused it because I was afraid I would lose you. Now... it's time to settle the debt owed by the Dragon.

The day I came back from the first meeting with you, I decided. I'm not going to let you die this time.

"I'll protect you no matter what. Trust me!"

Even if you're the strongest hero in the world who doesn't need help.

123060.description:
An orphan, Hanyul didn’t have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Hanyul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

(Source: Tapas)

123061.description:
"...I'm screwed."

On a normal day like any other, Duchess Juliana Auburn woke up from a dream. No, rather, it is I, "Isian," who remembered my past life.

Juliana Auburn was a character in a novel who did nothing but badmouth and find fault with her husband, his friends, and her own father who had forced her to marry an illegitimate man.

According to a spoiler comment that I read, she will be killed at the start of the novel.

"Why did I only remember everything now after I've already done all of those bad things to the male lead?!"

In order to avoid the novel's "bad ending," Juliana plans to divorce her husband, Evan, the male lead....

"I'll give you everything you want."

"Don't you know that the one who falls in love first loses?"

"Why should I apologize for staring at you because you're so pretty?"

...Isn't my husband's obsession more serious than I thought?

A blissfully ignorant rich kid falls in love with a popular male escort.

Kichiro Wakamiya's parents run their own company. He works part-time to save money for his grandma's birthday present. While on the job, he's unexpectedly tackled by Natsuo, a male escort. To make up for dragging Kichiro into his miss, Natsuo provides his services. Unable to forget their night together, Kichiro starts looking for Natsuo...

123063.description:
During the Showa era, there was a law in Japan that granted a detective diploma only to those who solved three difficult cases. Kouko, an aspiring detective, receives a request to find out who's threatening to murder Inukami-kun, the son of a prestigious family, who is staying at Shunjukan, a boarding house in Tokyo.

Kouko infiltrates Shunjukan as a cook who takes care of the lodgers, and starts to investigate. However, she's not good at cooking, or reasoning, so she's very busy! What's more, the four lodgers who live there are all crazy...?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and one extra.

123064.description:
"I want to do more dirty things with you."

Kinoshita is a handsome high school student who is slightly thick in the head, and has fallen in love with his cool classmate, Yano. Kino believed that he would be satisfied with just being friends, while he'd have sexual fantasies of Yano, but a seat rearrangement misunderstanding pushes him to confess to him...

(Source: arca comics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

123065.description:
The story centers on a Mexican gunslinger named Monica and a Japanese backpacker named Atsushi, who are bound and handcuffed together. They search for the same police officer for their own personal reasons.

(Source: Anime News Network)

123067.description: In 2021, Makito Harii, genius magician, was holding a one time only retirement show in Tokyo when he burned to death in an unexpected accident. He was 17 years old. Or so one would think. But he lived, finding himself reincarnated 400 years earlier in Medieval Europe during the age of the Witch Trials! Now he fights against the church which unjustly brands women as witches with his tricks disguised as miracles. It's like real magic!
synonyms: ทริกอลวน แม่มดอลเวง
Harry Makito - Magicien et Sauveur de Sorcières

title.native: 魔女に捧げるトリック

123068.description:
I entered a novel in which the heroine who reincarnated as a saintess has to walk on a thorny path. ‘Yeah, nope!’ I, who decided to walk on a flower path, abandoned the original frustrating family and adopted my bias as my dad in our first meeting.

“You, be my daddy!” The story’s final boss and villain! But now he’s just my dad. Fufu. “Daddy, why is your name also daddy? So cute.”

“What did you eat for breakfast? Handsomeness?” {a pun that I’m too lazy to explain} As I dream of a happy ending for Daddy, there’s just one more huge obstacle… The existence of the hero who would kill the final boss. Now that it’s come to this, let’s save my bias and the hero as an addition! If I have time, maybe the world too! However…

“I’ll kill you if you approach my daughter.” …Daddy keeps on raising the death flags. “You should take responsibility since you tamed me.” Somehow the hero is also obsessed over me, just what’s going on…?

Note: This is a one shot promotional manhwa for the novel of the same name.

title.native: 王様の仕立て屋～下町テーラー～
王様の仕立て屋〜フィオリ・ディ・ジラソーレ〜
title.romaji: Ousama no Shitateya: Fiori di Girasole

title.native: 王様の仕立て屋〜サルトリア・ナポレターナ〜

123072.description:
Yuu Oribe, a Japanese man living in the Thieves’ Market in Naples, Italy, is the only apprentice acknowledged by the legendary tailor hailed as “Michelangelo” by Naples’ most skilled artisans. When his unparalleled craftsmanship and the unmatched tradition of Italy are revived in a single suit, exquisite drama unfolds in the lives of those who wear it.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: 王様の仕立て屋〜サルト・フィニート〜

123073.description:
Grass is a powerful anti-war graphic novel, offering up firsthand the life story of a Korean girl named Ok-Sun Lee who was forced into sexual slavery for the Japanese Imperial Army during the second World War — a disputed chapter in 20th century Asian history.

Notes:
Included short story: Ro Salpyeoboneun Ilbongun 'Wianbu' (로 살펴보는 일본군 '위안부') by Myeong-Suk Yun.
Nominated to the Eisner Comic Industry Awards 2020.

123075.description:
The story is set on a state-of-the art Aegis vessel with the full cooperation of Japan's real-life Ministry of Defense and Maritime Self-Defense Force. The corpse of a Self-Defense Force member has been found — minus the left arm — and a spy has infiltrated the Aegis vessel. The heroine Ran is put in jeopardy, and Conan is forced to stand up against the dangerous Spy "X."

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Detective Conan: Private Eye in the Distant Sea

title.native: 名探偵コナン 絶海の探偵
title.romaji: Meitantei Conan: Sekkai no Private Eye

123076.description:
The romantic comedy centers around two people, both about 30. Mio Sudou is an office lady who has not had a boyfriend in five years and has forgotten what it is like to be in love. Shuji Majima is an overseas insurance consultant who has not had a girlfriend in seven years despite being highly eligible. Mio meets Shuji at a matchmaking party, but finds him revolting as he states, "I'm not into women." However, a provocative comment by Mio takes things in an unexpected direction.

Note: Katsura first serialized the manga digitally under the title Sex Go-Busata, Sotsugyou Shimasu (××ご無沙汰､卒業します｡), buts is also sold in compilation volumes under the title Otona nya Koi no Shikata ga Wakaranee! (大人にゃ恋の仕方がわからねぇ！).

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Adults Are Clueless About Falling in Love!
Otona nya Koi no Shikata ga Wakaranee!××ご無沙汰､卒業します｡
大人にゃ恋の仕方がわからねぇ！

123080.description:
God gave me a chance to relive my life. Before the rebirth, I had been used for the past 400 years as the empire's sword. And so, I swore to destroy the empire. I found the young prince of the country and became his teacher. I taught him how to become a tyrant and asked for the country.

"I will do the lady's will."

He conquered the whole empire for me, and I ran away.

"I came to take you, Charlize Ronan." Dylan became a perfect tyrant and searched the entire empire for me.

"You tamed me, so why did you run away?"
synonyms: I Tamed a Tyrant and Ran Away

123082.description: One day at school, a friend shows Hiroto Kyono a new app called "Meet your Soulmate". However, Kyono is indifferent to love and doesn't believe in fortune-telling apps...until Kyono meets a guy on the train who looks exactly like how the app described his soulmate! Could this guy really be his soulmate? How can Kyono close the distance between them so they can become friends? And then something more?
synonyms: Unmei no Hito to Deaeru Koisuru Apuri

title.native: 運命の人と出逢える恋するアプリ
title.romaji: Unmei no Hito to Deaeru Koisuru App

123084.description:
These dorky guys just hit the jackpot!

At this school, Tokura is the only girl that keeps the guys on their toes. A tall, stone-cold betty, Tokura presents a hard exterior and leaves all the weak guys at school afraid to talk to her. Sawarura though, while not that popular, thinks she’s a total bombshell and finds her trying to coax a cuddle from a neighborhood stray kitty. Shedding her cool attitude, Tokura’s face blushes, showing off her kind-hearted nature and the two bond over their love of cats. As a storm rolls in, the two take shelter and with the sound of thunder booming down, Tokura purrs up to Sawarura, sinking her claws into her newly found pet!

Half-Ripe Cherry by utu is a bountiful harvest of sultry, juicy women with sour demeanors that upon a little taste, reveal a great depth of body and sweetness. Jam-packed with nine tart chapters, utu continues to deliver the pouty lips, glossy hair, and tall, busty, confident women you come for. For fans of utu’s first FAKKU Books release, Shameless, see the continuing story of the high school exhibitionist Tsumiki-chan in “Anxious Tsumiki-Chan” as her jealousy pushes her to be more bold and risky than before!

These delicate boys are ready to get tied like a cherry stem around these girls’ fingers!

(Source: Fakku!)

1. Bokutachi no Makino-sensei (ぼくたちの牧野せんせい, Our Dear Makino-sensei)
2. Training Yahoo! (とれーにんぐヤッホー, Training Yahoo!)
3. Tokura-san wa Neko ga Suki! (戸倉さんは猫が好き！, Tokura-san Loves Cats!)
4. Jun-san no Tsumamigui (洵さんのツマミグイ, Jun-san Sneaks a Bite)
5. Yakimoki Tsumiki-chan (ヤキモキつみきちゃん, Anxious Tsumiki-chan)
6. Kana-chan Okaiage (カナちゃんお買い上げ, Kana-chan Purchase)
7. Tsuru no Uzu Uzu (ツルのウズウズ, Tingly Attraction)
8. Senpai Anone. (せんぱいあのね, Hey, Senpai.)
9. Fukigenna Hibiki-chan (不機嫌な響ちゃん, Pouty Hibiki-chan)
synonyms: ぼくたちの牧野せんせい
カナちゃんお買い上げ

title.native: はんじゅくチェリー

123085.description:
Betrayed by his allies and on the verge of death, the strongest exorcist, Haruyoshi Kuga, desired only one thing—to be happy in his next life. Using the secret art of reincarnation, he was transported to another world. Reborn as Seika Lamprogue, third son of a distinguished family of magic scholars, he's found to have no magical power whatsoever, which is an unacceptable shame in a family of mages.

However, he soon comes to realize that his new world's magic is nothing compared to the sorcery he mastered as an exorcist. With his control over divination, curses, and legions of youkai who serve him, his life in this new world should be a breeze! The only question is: how can he make use of those powers while laying low to avoid another untimely demise?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note - This Series has been published on M Novels Imprint and later has been published as Monster Bunko Imprint with new written adjustment and new Illustrator
synonyms: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Onmyoji ~These Monsters Are Too Weak Compared to My Youkai~

title.english: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World
title.native: 最強陰陽師の異世界転生記 ～下僕の妖怪どもに比べてモンスターが弱すぎるんだが～
title.romaji: Saikyou Onmyouji no Isekai Tenseiki: Geboku no Youkaidomo ni Kurabete Monster ga Yowai Sugirundaga

123088.description:
Complicated * new family!!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2018-04

123089.description:
Tohru Minasuki, a normal office worker, is reborn in another world after falling through a dimensional rift. A god grants him an ability called Skill Board upon his reincarnation. Taking advantage of this, he acquires essential skills—and an overpowered skill called Magic Blade. Despite his status as a stray—those known as inferiors for being seemingly incapable of leveling up—he pressed forward on the path to becoming the strongest!

(Source: K-Manga)
synonyms: Using the Skill Board as an Inferior Magic Swordsman to Become the Strongest

title.native: 劣等人の魔剣使い スキルボードを駆使して最強に至る
title.romaji: Rettou Hito no Maken Tsukai Sukiruboudo o Kushi Shite Saikyou ni Itaru

123090.description:
Comic artist Xiaoge Fang needs a lawyer, some smooth-talking hotshot who can sue his publishers for all they’re worth. That’s what they get for trying to screw him out of royalties, but… easier said than done for someone with an empty bank account. Enter Mo Qian, an attorney with a record almost as perfect as his looks. His offer? In exchange for representation, pretend to be his boyfriend to make his ex jealous. There's no way Xiaoge will accept. He’s not that desperate... right?

(Source: Tapas)

123091.description: A normal office worker, Toru Minasuki, was swallowed up by a dimensional fissure and reincarnated into a different world. Upon reincarnation, Toru was given a [skill board] by God. Make the most of it to acquire all the necessary skills! Even though he is an "inferior person," he'll make his way to the top!

title.native: 劣等人の魔剣使い スキルボードを駆使して最強に至る
title.romaji: Rettou Hito no Maken Tsukai Sukiruboudo o Kushi Shite Saikyou ni Itaru

123092.description: Himemiya Shin is a high school student who runs the light novel compilation site "Raneko of Light Novel". Through the creation of a certain article, he learns that the author of "This Love Comedy is Amazing", the work that won third place in a recent online novel contest, is the girl he has admired from afar all his life, Kyogetsu Yobun. This work was not a romantic comedy in the strict sense of the word, and it was far from being well written, but it was pushed to third place because it was propelled by a multitude of Internet users. But in reality, all of them were one and the same person: Shin. But when Yobun found out, she didn't get angry and instead asked him to help her write proper romance novels!

title.native: 《このラブコメがすごい！！》堂々の三位！
title.romaji: "Kone Love Come ga Sugoi!!" Doudou no Sanmi!

123093.description:
The Arnold Academy of Magic is a school for the elite...and Ray White is just your ordinary guy. In fact, he doesn't seem particularly skilled with magic at all, and is a bit of a klutz. Which is why he has nothing to do with the rumor that one of the great magicians, the Iceblade Sorcerer, is a member of the incoming class...right?

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: The Iceblade Magician Rules Over the World
เรย์ไวท์ จอมเวทดาบเหมันต์ เด็กหนุ่มจอมเวทผู้แข็งแกร่งที่สุดในโลก ได้เข้ามาร่ำเรียนในโรงเรียนเวทมนตร์

title.english: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
title.native: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べる ～世界最強の魔術師である少年は、魔術学院に入学する～
title.romaji: Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu: Sekai Saikyou no Majutsushi de Aru Shounen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ni Nyuugaku Suru

123094.description:
1. Kimi no Koto Suki Nanda (きみのことすきなんだ)
2. Otome no Thema (乙女のテーマ)
3. Knight no March (騎士（ナイト）のマーチ)

title.native: きみのことすきなんだ

title.romaji: Ura no Ie no Majo Sensei

123096.description:
In the heavily tinged aftermath of defeat, in November of Showa 19 (1944), Lieutenant Colonel Minoru Genda of the Imperial Japanese Navy established an elite squadron by gathering ace pilots from various locations, with the intention of being the "trump card for homeland defense."

That squadron would later become renowned as the legendary "Sword Squadron" - the 343rd Naval Air Group.

Centered around the protagonist, Naoshi Kanou, a man feared as the "Ace Killer" within the formidable 343rd squadron, this story depicts the extraordinary exploits of these young, fearless pilots with astonishing artistry!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

123098.description: Set in the distant future on the planet Hekiousei, which has been colonized by humans, the story follows the battles of a group of pregnant warriors who gain the ability to jump into space by having an alien organism implanted in their wombs. Prior to the main story "WOMBS", the pregnant warriors, Almere and her friends, who had not yet controlled their jumping ability, escaped from the army and went to the enemy country. They escape from the army and visit Binard, an obstetrician who is hiding in an enemy country, and demand an abortion...

123099.description: One who knows impurity and one who does not, and the fact that the two exist together...

123100.description:
I thought I was reincarnated as the daughter of a wealthy family, but it turns out I was born as the child of the greatest villain in the fantasy world of martial arts. My father doesn't care about me, I'm ostracized by the others, and I'll eventually be murdered as a side antagonist by the male lead, after suffering from my one-sided love.

Even worse, this is a world where the weak are the prey of the strong, conceited antagonists.

So, before it's late, I need to learn martial arts and escape!

However, there was a fatal flaw in my plan...

Because of my notorious father, there were too many people who sought to end my life.

"Wahhh! Dadda! (Daddy!)"

...Will I ever be able to escape safely?

Note: This is a promotional one shot manhwa for the novel

(Source: Korean publisher, translated)
synonyms: I Am the Precious Daughter of the Greatest Villain in the Fantasy World

123101.description:
If there is no “Beauty” in “The Beauty and the Beast”, then who shall lift the Beast’s curse?

“One day, someone trapped in a world of black and white will appear, and stain your world with blood.”

Thanks to this prophecy, the “Beast”, Prince Reynsis, was abandoned and left to fend for himself. To undo the curse, he needs the “Beauty”, but the only problem is-- "Who the hell is this beauty supposed to be?!"

I reincarnated into my own, incomplete novel before I wrote about the beauty’s appearance! All I know about the “Beauty” is that she has black hair and crimson eyes...but after witnessing Prince Reynsis’ unfortunate childhood firsthand, I resolved to go and find the Beast’s beauty myself!

Note: This is a promotional one shot manhwa for the novel.

123102.description:
I passed out after a day filled with misfortune. When I later opened my eyes, I was inside my favorite novel. Unfortunately, I was reincarnated as the villainess who was ruined after wreaking havoc due to her obsession with the male lead… That doesn’t matter! I won’t become a villainess, and will instead match my favorite character in this novel, the second male lead, with the heroine! But this is… harder than I imagined?!?!

“Are you alright?”

The captain of the knights who was supposed to be the heroine’s bodyguard ended up as my own.

“I got it for free on the way here. Eat it.”

The guy who is supposed to help the two end up together keeps going off track by 3000%.

“Are you out of your mind? I told you to be careful!”

And the male lead who is supposed to hate me is annoyingly hovering around.

”I’ll feed you, Lia!”

Even the heroine had no interest in anyone, not even the original male lead?! Not only that!

“Thank you. I’ll treasure it.”

My heart started beating for Ain who suddenly appeared without warning! Will Lia be able to save the second male lead’s love?

123103.description: Trap City, a crime city in which the first, second, and third thing you must beware of is people. Noah Humphrey stole away the boss' money and ran away with it amidst an inconspicuous war between the two greatest groups in the city. Will he live as a toy for the boss Kahliya, or as a bait for the boss Rex, leaders of the rivaling groups? A love story blooms during a critical situation in which you have to do anything in order to survive!

123104.description:
Former thug Choi Mun-hyeok will do anything to protect his younger siblings. When he’s defeated in an underground fight club and sold in an auction to Seo Yeonjin, he reluctantly allows himself to be put on a leash for his family’s sake. Yeon-jin, on the other hand, doesn’t care much for family. In fact, he intends to cause a scandal that will outrage his billionaire father by embarking on a twisted, carnal affair with Mun-hyeok. All Mun-hyeok needs to do is serve Yeonjin well, in work and in bed. However, their passionate encounters might turn into something greater than they bargained for. After all, the line between passion and madness is a thin one….

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

123105.description:
Two young men exist worlds apart, yet in a chance encounter, talented ballet dancer Shu Yun meets Tong Yang, a rising star of the Peking Opera. One of them is an accomplished son of a distinguished family with too many secrets, and the other, a diamond in the rough down on his luck… Somehow, they manage to find hope and light within each other. As their paths cross and intertwine, how will their lives change?

(Source: Tapas)

123106.description:
The high school girl Sato Sakura accidentally woke the sleeping vampire Noah when she moved into an old house with her family. A sip of her blood was enough to suppress his hunger for now. Sato wants to help Noah rediscover the joy of living, but how will she satisfy his sinful urges when he flashes that beautiful smile at her, lying next to her in bed!

Note: Chapter count includes 18 omake chapters.
123106.hashtag: #吸血鬼を飼うことになりまして
synonyms: Falling In Love With My Pet Vampire

title.native: 吸血鬼を飼うことになりまして
title.romaji: Kyuketsuki wo Kau Koto ni Narimashite

123107.description:
An alternate retelling of Snow White with a reincarnated Stepmother…

Note: This is a oneshot promotional webtoon for the novel.
synonyms: I'm Only a Stepmother, but My Daughter Is Just so Cute

123108.description:
Broke college student Ji-Ho is determined to win the grand cash prize on the TV show "The King of Home Cooking," where culinary mastery alone isn't enough to become popular with the audience voters. After a wild night of research, he concludes that faking a gay relationship with another contestant is the surest way to victory. The handsome and good-natured Woo-Hyuk could be the perfect partner -- but the instant he hears Ji-Ho's plan, Woo-Hyuk turns into a complete jerk! The two somehow agree to team up, but will their rocky "ship" be enough to beat the other attention-hungry contestants?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

123109.description:
I became the main character who beats around the bush in an angsty romance fantasy novel. The role of the heroine who gets thrown by the male lead and is ignored by her best friend. It can’t go this way! I have to change the original route by all means.

“Please employ me as your support.” To survive, I decided to stick to the antagonist, the crown prince, of the original plot. However, this man is in no way going as planned. To add, even a weird rumor is going around. That I and Palus are lovers, with plans of a wedding ahead.

“We’re not lovers. It’s just me who cannot live without her.”

Huh? What is this guy saying right now! Why is he adding fuel to the fire! “Crown Prince, the King said...” What of these bad rumors, this much I expected once I decided to be the Crown Prince’s support. “You have fallen for Noo-nim and that you cannot come to your senses.”

However, that wasn’t true. False rumors must have morality! In fact, he likes men! “That being blind to jealousy, you broke the wrist of a man, getting close to Noo-nim on spot.”

“……” No, I mean that’s not completely untrue. But, that might not be the reason…

“I also heard rumors that you might officially marry Noo-nim soon.”

“……” No. That’s never true!

Note: This is a one-shot promotional manhwa for the novel of the same name.
synonyms: I'm the Main Protagonist From Today

123110.hashtag: #ココノちゃんはナミだのみ

title.native: ココノちゃんはナミだのみ！

123111.description: Touya, the strongest player in the game Pandemic World Online, has won so many items that he decided to create an alternative account to store them while playing he was summoned to another world, but not having the category of hero is discarded and replaced by another person, now he will have to survive only in that world and with the character he created to store those items.
synonyms: A Mage is summoned to another world ~The undesired items are now the strongest~
被召唤的贤者闯荡异世界

title.native: 召喚された賢者は異世界を往く～最強なのは不要在庫のアイテムでした～
title.romaji: Shoukan Sareta Kenja wa Isekai wo Yuku: Saikyou nano wa Fuyou Zaiko no Item Deshita

123112.description: Touya, the strongest player in the game Pandemic World Online, has won so many items that he decided to create an alternative account to store them while playing he was summoned to another world, but not having the category of hero is discarded and replaced by another person, now he will have to survive only in that world and with the character he created to store those items.
synonyms: A Mage is summoned to another world ~The undesired items are now the strongest~

title.native: 召喚された賢者は異世界を往く～最強なのは不要在庫のアイテムでした～
title.romaji: Shoukan Sareta Kenja wa Isekai wo Yuku: Saikyou nano wa Fuyou Zaiko no Item Deshita

123114.description:
Just as your birth did not inspire me, so your death won't mean anything to me.

Jaina reincarnated as a supporting character who was born as mixed blood of human-dragon and died miserably after being neglected. She is branded as an unclean entity and was abandoned by the dragons.

And the first time she met her father, the lord of the tower, Diamide, he just looked at her coldly, as though he didn't feel any sense of intimacy to his daughter as described in the original.

"Is that the one you called my daughter?"

Jaina flinched as he approached and lowered her sight.

"Blue eyes... but that's not a proof that she's my daughter. You could have brought me a child born with another human."

And so he went back leaving her alone and Jaina was living in the shabby warehouse of the tower.

Rather than making vain efforts to get into the eyes of his father, the lord of the tower, she decided to have a small luxury that she had never experienced even in her previous life before her death.

"You don't have to think of me as your daughter. I won't call you father either."

"..."

"Tower's lord?"

So is the father, who should've been indifferent, starting to get obsessed? Father, can you just leave me alone?

123117.description:
Before he joined the Armed Detective Agency, Osamu Dazai was the youngest-ever executive with the Port Mafia, the most notorious underground crime syndicate in all of Yokohama. Three of its members-Dazai, Odasaku, and Ango-formed a camaraderie despite their vast disparities in rank. When Ango suddenly goes missing, Odasaku, a lowly Mafia grunt, receives direct orders from their boss to find him...only for Ango's trail to lead Odasaku to a mysterious, foreign criminal organization called Mimic.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: คณะประพันธกรจรจัด 2 ตอน ดาไซ โอซามุ กับยุคมืด
Bungou Stray Dogs: Mroczna przeszłość Osamu Dazaia

title.english: Bungo Stray Dogs: Osamu Dazai and The Dark Era
title.native: 文豪ストレイドッグス 太宰治と黒の時代
title.romaji: Bungou Stray Dogs: Dazai Osamu to Kuro no Jidai

123118.description:
Over a decade before the events of the manga series, a chance encounter leads professional bodyguard Yukichi Fukuzawa to begrudgingly take an arrogant boy genius named Ranpo Edogawa under his wing. Their first job brings them to a local theater on high alert after receiving a bizarre death threat-a challenge that will require both Ranpo's brains and Fukuzawa's experience. The aftermath spurs Fukuzawa to establish the Armed Detective Agency, an organization that takes on dangerous jobs even the police won't handle!

Plus, get a glimpse of the agency the night before Atsushi Nakajima joined the team!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: คณะประพันธกรจรจัด 3 ตอน เรื่องลับเบื้องหลังการก่อตั้งสำนักงานนักสืบ

title.english: Bungo Stray Dogs: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
title.native: 文豪ストレイドッグス 探偵社設立秘話
title.romaji: Bungou Stray Dogs: Tanteisha Setsuritsu Hiwa

123121.description:
The Armed Detective Agency's latest case brings them to the floating city Standard Island, a strange man-made vessel and a resort for the wealthy off the coast of Yokohama. But what awaits the detectives turns out to be far more complicated than any of them could have expected: a bomb, time travel, a mysterious skill user named H. G. Wells...Will this case spell the end of Yokohama itself?!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: คณะประพันธกรจรจัด 4 ตอน 55 Minutes

title.native: 文豪ストレイドッグス ５５Ｍｉｎｕｔｅｓ

123122.description: The first time he saw him, Tohru was on his way home from his hobby of taking photos. He’s queued for the Shinkansen’s unreserved seating, just right next to him.

title.native: うたの☆プリンスさまっ♪ マジLOVEレボリューションズ　アンソロジー
title.romaji: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji LOVE Revolutions Anthology

123124.description: Power users around the world are suddenly committing suicide one after another, in all cases after a strange fog appears at the scene. At a request from Ango Sakaguchi, the Armed Detective Agency head out to investigate Tatsuhiko Shibusawa, a power user who calls himself "collector," and a man suspected of being tied to the incident.
synonyms: คณะประพันธกรจรจัด ตอน DEAD APPLE

title.native: 文豪ストレイドッグス DEAD APPLE

123125.description:
What if the Port Mafia’s attack dog, Ryuunosuke Akutagawa, had joined the Armed Detective Agency? Likewise, what if Atsushi Nakajima belonged to the Port Mafia? In the parallel universe of Bungo Stray Dogs: Beast, Akutagawa’s desperate mission to rescue his younger sister from the Port Mafia’s clutches brings him face-to-face with the organization’s fearsome White Reaper…aka Atsushi Nakajima. What does fate have in store for this alternate tale of darkness versus light…?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 文豪ストレイドッグスBEAST

123126.description:
Not long after Ougai Mori takes the reins of the Port Mafia, he orders a young Osamu Dazai to investigate an ominous rumor of something called “Arahabaki.” Whoever or whatever it is seems to have some connection to Mori's deceased predecessor—and the new boss would very much like for the dead to stay buried. Along the way, Dazai runs into a gravity manipulator named Chuuya Nakahara, leader of the Sheep gang of youths. Together, the two will one day achieve infamy as the fearsome duo known as Twin Dark, but for now, they'll have to learn to put aside their differences if they want to get to the bottom of this mystery…

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Bungo Stray Dogs: Dazai, Chuuya, Age Fifteen
title.native: 文豪ストレイドッグス  太宰, 中也, 十五歳
title.romaji: Bungou Stray Dogs: Dazai, Chuuya, Juugosai

title.native: 悪役令嬢、時々本気、のち聖女。
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou, Tokidoki Honki, Nochi Seijou.

title.native: 悪役令嬢、時々本気、のち聖女。
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou, Tokidoki Honki, Nochi Seijou.

synonyms: さまよえる本に結末を　ウィルブック・ハンターあるいは甘い憂鬱

title.native: さまよえる本に結末を

123130.description:
"Satou Koharu is a pretty girl that everyone can recognize."

But her attitude with anyone is so bitter that she got nicknamed “Salt-God Sato-san." Anyone who tried to get close to her got emotionally injured in a brutal way. Though for some reason, I was able to save Sato-san from some pick-up boys where I was working at. Which made her like me, and thus I became a friend of “Salt-god Sato-san.” In front of everyone, she is a salt-god, but in front of me, she is very sweet. This is a high school life story of Satou-san and I.

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: 冷淡的佐藤同學只對我撒嬌
Aren’t You Too Sweet Salt-God Sato-San?
The Salt-God Sato-san is only sweet to me!
คุณซาโต้ยอดนักเมิน เธอหวานใส่ผมแค่คนเดียว
The Cold Sato is Only Sweet to Me

title.english: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me
title.native: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い＠comic
title.romaji: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai @comic

123131.description: Nanako Morito fell in love with her senpai Ayaka Segawa when Ayaka led Nanako's new employee orientation session. Morito kept her feelings to herself until she was jolted by the news that Segawa-san was quitting the company.
synonyms: 不乘末班車回去的維1方法
There's only one way to not return with the last train

title.native: 終電で帰さない、たった1つの方法
title.romaji: Shuuden de Kaesanai, Tatta Hitotsu no Houhou

123132.description:
Survival game for war, nuclear shelter, germ weapons, inheritance .... Dying girls face agony!
"What if I die tomorrow?" Yoshimi Seki's fierce panic horror collection that keeps asking about living in fear comics.

title.native: 関よしみホラーコレクション パニック！―あたし死ぬの？―
title.romaji: Yoshimi Seki Horror Collection: Panic! Atashi Shinu no?

123133.description:
Survival game for war, nuclear shelter, germ weapons, inheritance .... Dying girls face agony!
"What if I die tomorrow?" Yoshimi Seki's fierce panic horror collection that keeps asking about living in fear comics.

title.native: 関よしみホラーコレクション 超エゴ！―あたしサイテー？―
title.romaji: Yoshimi Seki Horror Collection: Chou Ego! Atashi Saite?

title.native: ベイビー・メニー・クライ

123135.description: Tomita Tomizou is in a band. After a night gig, Tomita runs into a fortune teller, who tells him a fatal encounter is just about to happen, someone unexpected will show in his band… Is it a friend, or maybe a new love? Could it be that the encounter already happened ?!

123136.description: Hundreds of years ago, 48 sexual positions were created and named, it is the equivalent to the Japanese kamasutra. It is likely that these moves were devised during the Edo period (1603-1868), reflecting the 48 set of moves that Sumo wrestling recognizes. 48 different manga artists came together and created one shots for each different position. In this first volume, 24 of those positions are featured.

title.native: 四十八手アンソロジー　秘宝館

123137.description:
Social norms, what his parents think... All those expectations he didn't care for as a kid now bother him to no end... Shinichi spends most of his days dealing with his mom trying to put him in an arranged marriage, and when he goes to an all guys' bar for the first time in a while, he bumps into his subordinate, Ataru.

In comparison to Ataru, who's happy because he believes it's destiny that they learn about each other in this way, what does Shinichi do about his conflicted emotions...?

(Source: Renta!)

synonyms: The Crowd: A Study of the Popular Mind

123140.description:
The villain Ling Chen has a history of hate and violence with the hero, Ye Zimu. Out of nowhere, a reset triggered Ling Chen to return to when he was 17 years old! He has a chance to stop the hero in his path, before Ye Zimu grows to become his worst enemy...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

123141.description:
After her life took a U turn, she buried her past and became a tough police woman, However, years into her career in uniform, she re-encounters the man from her bitter-sweet memory.

Now a sharp-tongued detective, he meets the girl that he used to share cherished moments with, Together, they will seek justice and rekindle what was once between them.

A story of crime investigation, and about how they become each other's salvation.

(Source: MangaToon)

123142.description:
1. Taikutsu na Heya (退屈な部屋, A Boring Room), Weekly Manga Sunday 1975-10
2. Sakana Ishi (魚石, Fish Stone), Big Gold No. 4 (November 1979)
3. Hi no Tawamure (日の戯れ, The Day's Amusement), Custom Comic No. 11 (January 1981)
4. Sanpo no Hibi (散歩の日々), COMIC Baku No. 1 (June 1984)
5. Ikebukuro Hyakutenkai (池袋百点会), COMIC Baku No. 3 (December 1984)
6. Tonari no Onna (隣りの女), COMIC Baku No. 4 (May 1985)
7.-12. Munou no Hito (無能の人, The Man Without Talent), COMIC Baku No. 5-9, 11 (June 1985 to December 1986)

title.romaji: Munou no Hito, Hi no Tawamure

123143.description:
Yuya's secret fetish is his love of wearing women's lingerie. As Yuya stares into a lingerie store window on his way home from work, he bumps into his old high-school classmate, Kazuaki. Yuya's obviously flustered state piques Kazuaki's curiosity, and a few days later, he pops the big question. "So, Yuya, do you like wearing women's lingerie?" In addition to the cover story, this compilation is full of bonus content, with two one-shots by the same author and two previously unpublished chapters of Angula Blue. Check out this slightly taboo yet surprisingly erotic love story!!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Ore ga Shitteiru Kare no Koto

title.native: アングラ・ブルー

123145.description: Born as the eldest daughter of a duke, she was raised and educated only to become Queen. Even though she had excellent fencing skills, she was not allowed to wield a sword. Nevertheless, she was happy. As Queen of the Kingdom of Mont, she was able to stay with her beloved King. But her happiness did not last long. The king betrayed her and had her executed. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself on the witch hunting ground outside the castle! People are calling her a witch and are trying to kill her. What is even going on?

123149.description:
I didn't think much of the creepy girl in class, but who would have thought...

(Source: Toomics, edited)

123150.description:
An ordinary teenager is transported to a fantasy world, accidentally gets on the bad side of the gods, and is dumped in the bottom of the world’s deepest dungeon with no skills or magic. Ouch! Once there, he meets a mysterious girl…who happens to be undead. But despite her general dislike of humans, she decides to help him out. Can the two of them make it back to the surface? They might just be a more powerful combo than anyone was expecting!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Disciple of the Lich: Or How I Was Cursed by the Gods and Dropped Into the Abyss!
The Disciple of Lich: This is Heroic Tale of Mine That I Incurred Evil God’s Displeasure and Dropped to the Abyss

title.native: 不死者の弟子 ～邪神の不興を買って奈落に落とされた俺の英雄譚～
title.romaji: Fushisha no Deshi: Jashin no Fukyou o Katte Naraku ni Otosa Reta Ore no Eiyuutan

123151.description:
An ordinary teenager is transported to a fantasy world, accidentally gets on the bad side of the gods, and is dumped in the bottom of the world’s deepest dungeon with no skills or magic. Ouch! Once there, he meets a mysterious girl…who happens to be undead. But despite her general dislike of humans, she decides to help him out. Can the two of them make it back to the surface? They might just be a more powerful combo than anyone was expecting!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Disciple of Lich: This is Heroic Tale of Mine That I Incurred Evil God’s Displeasure and Dropped to the Abyss

title.english: Disciple of the Lich: Or How I Was Cursed by the Gods and Dropped Into the Abyss!
title.native: 不死者の弟子　～邪神の不興を買って奈落に落とされた俺の英雄譚～
title.romaji: Fushisha no Deshi: Jashin no Fukyou wo Katte Naraku ni Otosareta Ore no Eiyuutan

123152.description:
I somehow learned of a special "spot" that could change my life and others...! But what will I do with this newfound power...?

(Source: Toomics)

123154.description:
Mitsuomi and Yamato fell for each other beneath the endless, unchanging countryside sky. Now, as the days go by in the small town where Mitsuomi was born and raised, and the foundling Yamato made his home, the two men are searching for the shape of their own happiness.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Khởi đầu mới từ bữa cơm nhà

title.native: リスタートはおなかをすかせて

123157.description:
"With this, isn't it possible for me to sell off the skills that others have?" he asked.
Heeding his grandfather's last words to, "enjoy another world," Mamoru gained access to the door to another world and the ability to "skill trade." And so he goes on a journey in the other world while making use of the omnipotent skill that allows him to buy and sell the valuable skills of others.

Miruka, a girl he met in the otherworldly town of Valenheim, possessed the cursed skill, "seeds of disaster." Because of it, a number of misfortunes have befell the people around her, causing her to fall into despair. However, Mamoru sells her skill and effectively releases her from her curse.
"From now on, Mamoru-sama is the master who I'll serve with all my sincerity."
Mamoru, on the other hand, earned a large sum of money by selling the skill, "seeds of disaster."

So begins Mamoru's adventure of getting out of the black company, selling and buying skills and growing begins!

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)
synonyms: "Skill Baibai" de Isekai Koueki: Black Kigyou de Yanda Kokoro o Sukutte Kureta no wa Isekai Deshita

title.native: 【スキル売買】で異世界交易　～ブラック企業で病んだ心を救ってくれたのは異世界でした～
title.romaji: "Skill Baibai" de Isekai Koueki: Black Kigyou de Yanda Kokoro wo Sukutte Kureta no wa Isekai Deshita

123160.description:
The main character, Seiji, who died in an accident, learned the cheat technique “Riot Grasper”, and was reincarnated into a world of swords and magic. Using the power of Riot Grasper to steal the useful skills of others, he fights to protect what is important. A story about the growth of Seiji who aims to fight 100% by "stealing".

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)
synonyms: Riot Grasper ~Stealing Skills in Another World~

title.native: ライオットグラスパー ～異世界でスキル盗ってます～
title.romaji: Riot Grasper: Isekai de Skill Tottemasu

123162.description:
After reincarnating as a shield, I woke up in a wintry kingdom where it snows all year long. Others neglected me, calling me a "dirty shield." But the Sixth Prince picked me up and treated me kindly.

"I promise to always protect you!"


(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Shield of the Green King and the Country in Eternal Winter

title.romaji: Ryokuou no Tate to Mafuyu no Kuni

123163.description: A meddlesome girl, Setsuko, tries to speed along the painfully slow progress of the relationship between her two childhood friends, Yusuke and Saori. But, instead, she's managed to unwittingly...
synonyms: Love Disasters of a Meddlesome Girl
The End Result of a Meddlesome Girl's Efforts to Play Matchmaker for Her Friends

title.native: お節介女子が友人同士の恋の応援をし続けた結果
title.romaji: Osekkai Joshi ga Yuujin Doushi no Koi no Ouen wo Shitsuzuketa Kekka

123164.description:
Doujima just sits there without any expression on his face. But I bet he's thinking about naughty things like A, B, C or WXY, or... What about me? I would never think those things! Baka!

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 大人すぎるマイラバー

123166.description:
Matsurika, a female officer in the Inner Palace, had a little special skill, and that was "a better memory" than others. One day, she accepted a request to become a practice partner for a marriage meeting of a certain son of a distinguished family. However, the one who appeared was the Emperor, Hakuyou, who wanted to try having a marriage meeting?! And interested in Matsurika's special skill, Hakuyou even said, "For now, go and pass the civil exam"...?!

A Chinese-style Cinderella story between an emperor and a girl!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

123168.description:
Two voices guide the morals of lovestruck teen Kenta Kodama - the voice of "virtue", and the voice of "sin", which beckons him into temptation...... and they've been fighting daily in his head. Just when the serious, straight-laced but naive voice of virtue is struggling against the advances of the sexually-rampant voice of sin, their host Kenta hits puberty and his libido shoots sky-high! What happens to the power balance between "virtue" and "sin" when the tables are turned......!? This is a super-salacious romantic comedy that anthropomorphizes worldly desires!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Akuma de Iiko de Itai n da
The Demon Wants to be a Good Boy

title.english: I Just Wanna Be a Good Boy
title.native: アクマでイイコでいたいんだ
title.romaji: Akuma de Ii Ko de Itai n da

123169.description:
I never noticed this place existed... But I desperately needed to be comforted. Just what is this Daddy's Room?

(Source: Toomics)

123170.description:
Aono's out of money and out on the street. He ends up crashing at his coworker Yazu's place. In exchange, Yazu wants to do it once a week! It's Aono's first time with a guy, but that doesn't stop him from getting all wet and messy with the super aggressive Yazu...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Once a Week Just Isn't Enough!
title.native: 週１エッチじゃ物足りない！

123171.description:
A lot of things happen in the office. You think lying low and just doing your work will do the trick, but there's always trouble stirring up somewhere.

(Source: Toomics)

123172.description:
Jiyoon Cha is just trying to live her best life in spite of feeling unfulfilled by her corporate job and disillusioned with love. But what’s a woman in her 30s to do when the pressure to marry is high, her prospects are either her aloof supervisor or her juvenile, artist ex-boyfriend, and not even her perfect work friend can hold it together? Can a girl just have her chicken and beer in peace, or is that just a pipe dream?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: พรุ่งนี้ต้องทำงานอีกแล้วเรอะ!

123173.description:
Sachio hates his face. It's a stark reminder of the past that haunts him on a daily basis. People don't see him, they only see his face. As Sachio grows, he takes it upon himself to start fresh in Tokyo, where no one will know him—for his past or his face. That is, until he meets his neighbor Onda who just so happens to have the same face as him?! What's in store for these two, as Sachio is now confronted on a regular basis with the face he has come to hate so much?

Notes:
Originally serialized under the title "Stay Halation: Yoku Nita Futari no Otokonoko" (ステイ・ハレーション よく似たふたりの男の子)
Contains the extra "Itsumo Mieru Basho ni Ite" (いつでも見える場所にいて).
synonyms: Stay Halation: Yoku Nita Futari no Otokonoko
ステイ・ハレーション よく似たふたりの男の子

title.native: オレ、その顔きらいです

123174.description: "Samguk Jeontugi” is a comic that parodies the Romance of Three Dynasty, one of the most popular classic novels in Korea and Japan. It is a mix of history and novel so don’t take it too seriously.

123175.description:
Natsuhiko was, until recently, a friendly and popular boy at his school. But one day, everybody started ignoring him! What did he do wrong? He doesn't know… Disillusioned, he searches for a place where he can eat alone, that is when he meets Ema, a half-Japanese girl. He feels that he might have found a new confidant, but…

(Source: Akata)

123176.description:
When she came back to life, she became an extra in a novel. Living in the palace of the cruel emperor’s as a villainess concubine, her throat was cut because she tormented the heroine!

What should I do at this moment?

Get close to the heroine? No.

Get close to the male lead? No, not that either.

Survive to have long and fine life? All of it!

Three years have passed since she lived peacefully as an outsider of the Imperial City. As long as the novel ends with a happy ending, she thought she could be free.

“Who are you…”

“All this time…”

…What?

“I’ll listen to you.”

“Huh?”

“I’ll listen to whatever you say. Can we live together then?”

The servant who came into my easy life.

I live a happy life with him. Sometimes he’s a kind servant, and other times, a dear friend…The problem is, I can’t seem to take my eyes off him when he smiles saucily and flirtatiously with those red eyes.

…Is it because of my feelings?

123177.description:
Azuma Sakuragi is deeply in love... with his twin brother, Miyabi! Miyabi is a pure genius at archery, but pretty much useless at everything else. You would think Azuma would be fed up with taking care of him all the time, but instead, he's happy to spend as much time with Miyabi as he can... until one day, the A.C. in Miyabi's room breaks down, and Miyabi has to sleep in Azuma's room... and share his bed! Can Azuma keep himself from secretly touching his brother?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 兄貴の一番おいしいところ

123178.description:
Despite being a lowly palace eunuch, Bi Xie possesses the brilliance of a strategist who is able to assist the Emperor in reclaiming feudal lands, expelling the Huns and bringing peace to the nation. He soon garnered the loyal support of various ambitious and talented men by his side.

However, his motives are hidden deep underneath his impeccable façade as he is harboring a deep family grudge against the imperial family...

123179.description: A high school teacher - Ichinose Akira, who is going to marry soon, has a secret. she is a virgin! One day she met her childhood friend Kyou who used to play as a doctor when they were small. He has now become a real doctor and by a chance examine her, and he make a revenge on pranks that she did to him while they were small....!? His fingers, lips, feels so nice--. absolutely she can't say this to anyone...!!

title.native: あきら先生は誰にも言えない
title.romaji: Akira Sensei wa Dare ni mo Ienai

123181.description:
Normal college student Kazuki Hirasawa finds himself inside the body of Harold Stokes, an evil character in the world of Kazuki's favorite game, Brave Hearts. The problem is, if the game's events go as they should, he'll one day find himself defeated by the hero's party. Will he be able to find a path to survival and avoid his many death flags using the incredible power of Harold Stokes's body and his own knowledge of the game? Join Harold in this magnificent manga adaptation of the work that won the 3rd Shosetsuka ni Naro Contest.

(Source: One Peace Books)
synonyms: My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending

title.english: My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending
title.native: 俺の死亡フラグが留まるところを知らない
title.romaji: Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai

123182.description:
A man gets a job being a caretaker for a rich woman and her two beautiful daughters. The madam of the house gives him just one chance, as long as he never interacts with her daughters. Well they won't make it easy for him to do that...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

123183.description:
The Golden Dragon has sent the legendary sword into the world so that, when Black Dragon that is bound to come to destroy the world appears, a hero might take hold of the sword to slay the world-destroyer before his foul designs are wrought. Who could possibly wield the sword of legend to become the hero of legend who is fated to engage in a fight of legend with the evil dragon of legend?

As time reveals, Alfonso, an elder of the village, is and always has been the chosen one. And now, as the fated hero of legend, he must lay aside his elderly ways and stride forth on his quest of legend and find the Golden Dragon of legend so he may gain the powers of legend to defeat the Black Dragon of legend in a legendary fight to stave off the legendary Armageddon.

Note: chapter count includes 1 prologue and 1 special

123184.description:
"I'll shove it all the way in this time around."

Saeki is a university professor who has just found out that his boyfriend of two years was cheating on him with a woman. At a bar, Saeki gets incredibly drunk, confuses the person sitting next to him for his ex, and ends up getting nasty with him in the restroom. The next day, a student comes up to Saeki after class. It turns out to be the guy from the bar! His name is Yamamoto, and he apparently came to pick up where they left off...!

This is a story between a cute puppy-like student who can get a little rough and a university professor who likes it that way.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Hey Teach... I'll Make You Feel Good
title.native: 先生、気持ちいいことシてあげます

123185.description:
Kohaku, a dog beast person, sneaks into a hospital that treats people with his condition. He tries to steal suppressants because his body has gone into heat. But, unfortunately, he's caught and falls unconscious on the spot...! When Kohaku wakes up, he see a doctor at the hospital, Dr. Takatsuji, looking down at him. Even though the doctor gives Kohaku a suppressant, his body's still in heat. As he tries to calm down the confused Kohaku, Dr. Takatsuji starts checking him for abnormalities... Kohaku has his shirt lifted up, his chest groped, and his nipples pinched... Even though he's only being examined, his body can't stop quivering...! Dr. Takatsuji doesn't notice how Kohaku is reacting and his fingers start to dig in deeper and deeper...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The "Growth" Progress Of The Sexy Helper Dog
title.native: えっちなおてつだい犬の性長記録
title.romaji: Ecchi na Otetsudai Inu no Seichou Kiroku

123186.description:
Princess Maeve lives in Aigina, a small country at the outskirts of the region. One day, she spends a night with Prince Carlin of Grango, and finds out that 'he' is in fact, a princess, not a prince...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

123187.description:
The unpredictable trial of a girl who was nothing at school begins!

Ordinary Park Ga-Eul witnesses the secret affair of Han Yu-Hyeon, who belongs to the so-called 'popular group', and uses this to blackmail Han Yu-Hyeon to join the group she admired...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 side story chapters
synonyms: รักฉันสิ นายฆาตกร

123188.description:
Miyatake and Saijou are the best of friends and the best of rivals. The two are exceptionally tall and skilled basketball players on the same team, but who would have thought their surprisingly harmonious friendship-slash-rivalry would continue off-court? With their eyes on the same goal - and the same boy - will they be able to remain the perfect team for much longer? "My Neighbor is Handsome and I'm Ugly": Manabu can tell you that the way you experience the world depends on whether you are handsome or ugly. Manabu has found himself to be in the latter group. With a grudge against handsome men seemingly floating through life, how will Manabu deal with his new neighbor, Ikeda, who is as handsome as handsome could be?

(Source: Futekiya)

123189.description:
The tale of Snow White, re-invented!

Learning her stepmother had been trying to kill her for the last ten years, Yi Hwa flees from the palace for her life. She desperately searches for Sa-eon, firmly believing he will help her out... But when she finally finds him, he flat out refuses to take her in, as he has enough of a hard time trying to support his six siblings. No matter how much Yi Hwa pleads with him, Sa-eon's answer is an unwavering "no" - an answer which she, of course, refuses to accept!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

123190.description: Seoina, an art college student, freely has sex with her three male friends. One day, she suddenly declares that she has someone she wants to be with. What choices will Seiona's three friends make to deal with a future without her?

123191.description:
A gloomy woman in her late twenties is currently being teased all over by a handsome and outgoing guy!

Having had to work on a weekend and missing her train on top of that, she was wandering around looking for a hotel to stay in. What's this? A handsome playboy wandering around the motel district trying to pick people up through social media? Even though she was scared, she politely refused but was still uneasy about camping outside late at night. She ended up believing that he wouldn't do anything, but when they got to the motel... Well, this gloomy woman ends up in a too-good-to-be-real accident, rousing this handsome guy who ends up taking her firsts in almost everything!

A steamy love story between a handsome, outgoing, two-faced guy and a round, gloomy girl in her late twenties.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: # Uraomote Danshi to Hatsukoi no Hajimekata

title.english: How to Fall in Love with a Two-Faced Boy
title.native: ＃ウラオモテ男子と初恋のはじめ方

123192.description: It's been three weeks since Izumi and his son moved in the Asakura household, after Izumi's apartment was burned down by a fire. Although both of them knew they were fond of each other, Izumi was originally careful about Asakura and restrained his body and mind from unleashing his passion on Asakura. On the other hand, Asakura is wondering how to approach Izumi and his new feelings of love and lust. How are these two dads going to manage their love of each other?

123193.description:
Fujiwara hates the school's hero, Ichijyou. In an attempt to get revenge on him, he tries to get a girlfriend first, but it's all to no avail. One day, Ichijyou confesses his love to him. Hoping to take advantage of his weakness, Fujiwara agrees to date him, but that's when the unexpected happens, and Ichijyou boldly pushes him down in the classroom...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: レイズ・オン・ファンタジー ギャンブラーは異世界を謳歌する
title.romaji: Raise On Fantasy: Gambler wa Isekai wo Ouka suru

title.native: 伊勢崎ウェポンディーラーズ

123197.description:
This new story connects the "Pre-arc" about Orphen's student days and the series' first novel.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 魔術士オーフェンはぐれ旅 コミクロンズ・プラン

123199.description:
The employee that was hired as the manager of this desolate hotel is surrounded by cute girls. A slapstick love comedy that takes place in a resort hotel.

Included one-shots: Oshiete Senpai!, Gift, Summer Beach

title.native: ただいま満室中(フルハウス)♥

123200.description:
When I took off his dress and kissed him, I got excited down there...!? The first person I want to have sex with was a "crossdresser."

(Source: Coolmic)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into three parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: あさひくんは、なまいきざかりなおとこの娘。

title.native: あさひくんは、生イキざかりの男の娘。
title.romaji: Asahi-kun wa, Namaiki Zakari no Otokonoko.

123201.description:
Toru Miyama has a special ability: he can read other people's minds! One day, he randomly bumps into Mizuki Hikawa, a stunning male model that he secretly adores. So what other choice does Toru have but to read Mizuki's thoughts? Turns out that Mizuki is really into BDSM, and he wants Toru to be his partner. He's willing to put Toru to the test to find out whether he makes the cut or not, but turns out that getting into BDSM isn't as easy as Toru had thought...

(Source: Animate International)

title.native: 歌舞伎町バッドトリップ
ごっくん!マイダーリン

123203.description: The story of an innocent cat(girl) who demands constant attention, and her somewhat awkward human.
synonyms: Defenseless kitty who gets lonely very easily

title.native: 寂しがり屋のむぼうびニャンコ

123204.description:
Han Che and Jiang Yichen like each other, but both of them are shy and sensitive. As a result, the relationship between them gets more and more strained. Xu Chen, a boy who always takes advantage of Han Che, makes fun of Han Che each time he meets him, which, on the other hand, gives Xiao Xinan who has a crush on Jiang Yichen a chance to get close to him.

(Source: Webcomics)

123205.description:
I tried to save the sub male lead, who was poisoned by the female lead, but an accident happened! He said he would repay the favor, but he randomly sent me to the most notorious villain, the Family of Assassins?!

The family that consists of the oldest brother, a knight in the Imperial Army preparing for a revolt, the second brother, a reverend with a large bounty on his head, and a father who is the greatest villain of all time...

Will I be safe in this villainous family throughout my three-year contract?

Note: Promotional prologue for the homonym web novel.
synonyms: Saving the Villain Who was Abandoned by the Female Lead
Methods to Save the Villain Who Was Abandoned by the Heroine
สาวใช้อย่างข้าจะช่วยตัวร้ายเอง!

123206.description:
Kalia is a war hero and commander that put an end to the past war. But one day, she finds out that she's... pregnant?! Of all people, the father of the baby is Simon Terroan, her best friend and archmage, whom she spent a single passionate night with.

Believing that Simon doesn't want the baby, Kalia hides the truth of her pregnancy, then retires from her job and disappears while Simon is away in order to have her baby. But the truth is that Simon has loved Kalia, more than anyone else. And so, the frantic search for her begins.

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.

123207.description:
Double riding from above and below is OK ♥

(Source: Fakku)

title.native: 影山さんのタンデムシート

123208.description:
"This world is full of noise."

Due to his innate ability to "read minds", Miura is completely distrustful of people because he is constantly exposed to their true feelings. One day, he meets Abe, his junior at a university club, who is twice as quiet and expressionless as anyone else. But it turns out, Abe is a person who will talk non-stop like a machine-gun about his pure love for Miura (*only in his mind)!

123209.description:
"How did you manage to hide this lewdness under that suit?" Kudo is a successful elite office worker, but he's always been regretting he didn't know real love. When he meets younger - but daring and intriguing - carpenter Sato, he finds himself unable to resist the pleasure of being possessed by a man, even though, as a supposedly straight man, he feels he should find it demeaning. But, Sato doesn't hide that he's serious about Kudo, and pushes him to go one step beyond the tentative, fake relationships he's tried to build with women until now...?! A grown-up first love story, vividly awaking the feelings you discover when you seriously fall for someone for the first time in your life.

(Source: futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Under My Skin 隱於此身皮囊下

123210.description:
Nara Lee, an ambitious and diligent 35 years old, has finally achieved her dream: buying a rooftop apartment! Little did she know she wouldn't have time to enjoy it, as she ends up reincarnated as the 8 years old Sharon Atrina, a side character in her favourite webnovel, "The Queen's Extravagant Outing." As Sharon, a wealthy and beautiful noblewoman, she has everything she could possibly want, but she's destined to die a pitiful death at the age of 20 after being betrayed by her best friend, Carol — the villainess!

Rather than waiting for death, she takes it upon herself to raise Carol — whose terrible personality resulted from bad parenting — into a better person, and save both of their lives to change their future!

Note: This is a promotional one shot manhwa for the novel of the same name.

123211.description:
As the worst delinquent of his grade, Kikuma Teranishi is forced to change dorm rooms after breaking the school rules one too many times. Reluctantly entering his new room, he comes face to face with the dorm superintendent, Takasumi Uryuu, who stirs in him hitherto unknown feelings... Kikuma's body tingles, and he wants to take out his urges on Takasumi... What is going on? The next time Kikuma breaks the school rules, Takasumi lays down a ground rule that sparks their relationship: "If you obey, I'll reward you. If you don't, you get punished."

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Absolute Submission - Like Hell I'll Obey!-
title.native: 絶対、服従命令～俺が言う事きくわけねェ！～
title.romaji: Zettai, Fukujuu Meirei: Ore ga Iu Koto Kiku Wake ne

123212.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot manhwa for the novel of the same name.

123213.description: Promotional prologue for the homonym web novel.

123214.description:
When I opened my eyes, the first thing I realized is that I am not a living person. Who am I? Why am I wandering around this place? And who is that man who visits my grave every week?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

123215.description: The three beasts of Son Goku, Sagojo, and Inohakkai, who were known as the strongest bounty hunters to hunt monsters. They stopped their activities after the incident of 80 years ago, and resumed their activities when they met a girl named Gen Xu. In this way, the four men will aim to become the heavens in order to subdue Sharamer, a cash prize of 2 trillion yen. Whereabouts of that journey and how!?

123216.description: This is a story about Hayashida Megumi (known as Lindaman), from the manga Crows, set in his middle school years. Hayashida is an incredibly strong, ridiculously large and very taciturn 'yankee' type middle schooler. Yoshidome Keiichi, a much smaller, weaker, and very talkative classmate starts to hang out with him, and slowly they become friends. All the while, large groups of people keep coming to attack 'Lindaman', due to grudges they have against him or even simply because of his reputation as being very strong.

title.native: クローズ外伝 リンダリンダ

123217.description:
Sabitsuki was once dead, but her parents managed to bring her back to life after countless experiments and mistakes. Now that she’s alive, her parents are worried about how she died in the first place, so they prepare everything in order for her to learn to enjoy life again. But being alive means to suffer sometimes, and therefore, happiness can’t last forever.

Manga doujinshi by Mariyasu, a user on pixiv, based on the game of the same name, by lol_rust.

(Source: Dreamless Window)

123222.description:
1-3. Zasshoku Yuusha (Omnivorous Hero)
4. Jikyuu 1500 yen!! Gyogyou o Tetsudau Kantan na Oshigoto desu. (Dansei nomi Bashou) Zenpen (Earn 1500 Yen! Help wanted at fishery! Easy Job! [Only male applicants please])
5. Gyoryuushima no Okite ~Jikyuu 1500 yen!! Gyogyou o Tetsudau Kantan na Oshigoto desu. (Dansei nomi Bashou) Kouhen~
6-7. Ajin Iryou Sougou Center e Youkoso! (Welcome to the Demi-Human Medical Center!)
8-9. Kindan no Shohousen (The Forbidden Prescription)
synonyms: How To Corrupt A Monster Girl

title.native: モンスター娘の堕とし方

123223.description: Kiryuuin Kirari, a rich young lady who doesn't know anything of the world, is introduced by her mother to the historic Meisou Bookstore, which will be the setting of her first part time job experience. It turns out the Meisou Bookstore is in fact filled with anime goods, doujinshis and idol lives, a true otaku bookstore!

title.native: きらりブックス迷走中！

123224.description: An alternative version of the light novel "Shokugyou, Shounin".

title.native: 孤独なビッチ 異世界風俗のモン娘とエルフと魔王和え
title.romaji: Kodoku na Bitch: Sekai Fuuzoku no Monster Musume to Elf to Maouae

title.native: 壊天の召喚撃退士〈バハムートテイマー〉

123228.description:
Ichigo Washio is a young man with a bright future—a bright future, that is, within the gangs of Shinjuku. When he meets Ringo Takamizawa, a fellow student hell-bent on revenge on those who took everything from his mother, the gregarious Ichigo doesn't think twice about helping Ringo—even when it means it’ll pit Ichigo against men he's looked up to his whole life. But Ichigo knows he's in the right, and with his new friends and a healthy dose of stupidity to guide him, he's ready to return justice to Shinjuku's streets! From the author of Tokyo Revengers!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

synonyms: The Another World Demon King's Successor

title.native: 異世界魔王の後継者（サクセサー）

123232.description: After junkies start disappearing in the city, one fighter and his live-streaming friend decide to investigate.

123233.description:
The chef Haruki Shindo accidentally transmigrates to another world, where he is blessed with the power of “Kensei,” a swordsman of god-like skill. He has mastered the blade such that he can slay a dragon with a single stroke. But he wields his blade not against demons nor dragons, but rather on the vegetable that he had grown himself! Haruki's culinary skills become highly valued, and he is taken to Lord Tamamo's castle. Haruki is called upon to create a variety of dishes to meet the impossible demands of the Lord Tamamo!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: A cook having the title of the great swordmaster.

title.native: 剣聖の称号を持つ料理人
title.romaji: Kensei no Shougou wo Motsu Ryourinin

title.native: おひとりさまでした。 ～アラサー男は、悪魔娘と飯を食う～
title.romaji: Ohitori-sama Deshita. Arasaa Otoko wa, Akuma Musume to Meshi wo Kuu

123236.description:
Hina (23) really hates taking a bath. 'Coz it's too much of a pain! However, her boyfriend, Teppei (23), tries to make her take a bath with various strategies! Can Hina still continue to be stubborn until the end!?

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.
synonyms: Girlfriend Who Absolutely Doesn’t Want to Take a Bath VS Boyfriend Who Absolutely Wants Her to Take a Bath

title.native: 絶対に風呂に入りたくない彼女VS絶対に風呂に入れたい彼氏
title.romaji: Zettai ni Furo ni Hairitakunai Kanojo VS Zettai ni Furo ni Iretai Kareshi

123237.description:
Pay up and do your thing. Naked ☆ virgin ♪

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2020-01

123238.description:
Yamanaka Suguru always viewed his "first times" as challenges to overcome. But when a girl suddenly confessed to him and become his girlfriend, she introduced him to countless new challenges that he's never known about.

(Source: Comikey)

Note: The chapter count includes 3 extra chapters.

synonyms: Advance of Z: Mace of Judgment

title.native: 機動戦士Zガンダム外伝 審判のメイス
title.romaji: Kidou Senshi Z Gundam Gaiden: Shinpan no Mace

title.native: 魔女の世界で最強なのは物理ですが何か？
title.romaji: Majo no Sekai de Saikyou na no wa Butsuri Desu ga Nani ka?

synonyms: Lunch Break at the Secret Table.

title.native: 昼休み、内緒のテーブルで。

synonyms: Private Kindergarten from a Different World
I want to know your pain

title.native: 異世界からエッチなお姫様が嫁入りです！
title.romaji: Isekai kara Ecchi na Ohime-sama ga Yomeiri desu!

title.native: 記憶の糸 坂の上の魔法使い外伝
title.romaji: Kioku no Ito: Saka no Ue no Mahoutsukai Gaiden

synonyms: Saka no Ue no Mahoutsukai DJ

123249.description:
The dapper staff of The Watering Hole are always eager to serve their clientele with grace and charm. But little do the patrons know that these handsome gents are actually penguins in disguise! The sharplydressed flightless birds love all that the human world offers, but as the saying goes: “You can take thepenguin out of the Antarctic, but you can’t take the Antarctic out of the penguin!”*

*Not all penguins come from the Antarctic.**** Yes, this actually matters in the world of Penguin Gentlemen.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes a prologue and epilogue.

123250.description: The princess lives alone in the island. A boy shows up in front of her?!
synonyms: The Familiar Spirit Sanmai and the White Magician

title.native: 使い魔サンマイと白の魔導師
title.romaji: Tsukaima Sanmai to Shiro no Madoushi

123251.description:
The Prince Commander of the North wants the daughter of the Shen family as his concubine. In order to give his adoptive mother a better life in her old age, the family's mute servant, Shen Yu, conceals his gender and takes the daughter’s place. But Shen Yu is afraid that once his identity is revealed, he’ll be executed. To his bewilderment and relief, he only attracts the attention of the Prince even more... but is that really a good thing?

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: 愛も憎しみも沈黙の中で

123252.description:
A long time ago the first celestial emperor decided to create Cheonjihae, an organization of 27 beings with fantastic powers in charge of maintaining the peace of the celestial world. Our heroine is destined to become the “Yellow Dragon”, the main defender of this association. Will she succeed in protecting the fragile balance of the heavens, despite the growing tension between the different races? And what to do when the organization itself does not believe in its mission anymore?

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

123253.description:
For fans, pro baseball can be more exciting than fictional dramas. The person responsible for making these games happen is the GM (General Manager). He must have a cool head, smart judgment, and the ability to make predictions based on limited information. It is a game of high-level psychological warfare, fighting with numbers to pierce the opponent with perfect timing. It is a fierce war that takes place outside the stadium, as GMs try to scout and build the strongest team.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

123254.description:
In the middle of the night, by mistake, I end up doing it with my boyfriend's brother...! I moan quietly next to my sleeping fiance... I shouldn't be doing this, but I can't resist...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: My Virginity Was Stolen Next to My Fiancé
title.native: 「初めて」は婚約者の隣で奪われる！？
title.romaji: "Hajimete" wa Fiancé no Tonari de Ubawareru!?

123255.description:
A collection of short stories:
1. Numa (沼, The Swamp), Monthly Manga Garo 1966-02
2. Chiiko (チーコ, Chirpy), Monthly Manga Garo 1966-03
3. Hatsu Take-gari (初茸がり, Mushroom Hunting), Monthly Manga Garo 1966-04
4. Tsuya (通夜, The Wake), Monthly Manga Garo 1967-03

6. Ri-san Ikka (李さん一家, The Lee Family), Monthly Manga Garo 1967-06

9. Akai Hana (紅い花, Red Flowers), Monthly Manga Garo 1967-10
10. Nishibetamura Satsujin Jiken (西部田村殺人事件, The Incident at Nishibeta Village), Monthly Manga Garo 1967-12
11. Chouhachi no Yado (長八の宿, Chohachi Inn), Monthly Manga Garo 1968-01
12. Futamata Keikoku (二岐溪谷, Futamata Gorge), Monthly Manga Garo 1968-02
13. Ondol Koya (オンドル小屋, The Ondol Shack), Monthly Manga Garo 1968-04

17. Mokkiriya no Shoujo (もっきり屋の少女, The Mokkiriya Tavern Girl), Monthly Manga Garo 1968-08
18. Kani (蟹, The Crab), Gendai Comic 1970-01-08
